scientific_conclusions.candidate_reachability: Family-Balanced increases from 11/60 rank-one exact to 31/60 oracle Recall@4, while V7 increases from 10/60 to 18/60. scientific_conclusions.mechanistic_limit: This establishes candidate reachability under one deterministic Batch1 Beam-4 condition, not a causal explanation of how training created the advantage and not proof that a deployable target-blind selector can recover it.
scientific_conclusions.research_priority: The highest-information next question is target-blind candidate selection, not another supervised repair round, larger beam, or additional family reweighting.
scientific_conclusions.generalization_boundary: The result reuses TARGET_DEV and is development evidence only. Oracle Recall@4 cannot be represented as deployed rank-one accuracy or independent ARC generalization.
